tips: Every session starts with a 15m run and ends with a 15m walk. These cardio bookends prime your dopamine and flush stress water.
Intensity rule: Sets 1 and 2 stay at 1–2 RIR. Only take the 3rd (final) set to absolute muscular failure on designated exercises.
Abs are completely consolidated into Day 4 to save time on Days 1–3 and eliminate rushing.
You are an athlete in a high-stress preparation phase. The gym's job is to relieve stress, not produce it.
Sleep is the training session. When work intensity spikes, your brain uses sleep as a survival mechanism. Honor it.
Heavy Tempo on Leg Press (3s down, 1s pause) protects your knees and builds deep quad density without overloading your spine.
High cortisol can bloat the scale by 5–8 lbs overnight with water retention. Flush it with your post-workout walks and deep sleep.

days.name: Quads, Core & Power
days.intro: Gym-based metabolic crucible. Balances leg volume with quad extensions, hits a dedicated core tri-set, and delivers an athletic shoulder pump. All week's abs live here.
